source.title: A chemical genetics approach reveals H,K-ATPase-mediated membrane voltage is required for planarian head regeneration.
source.location: Results text, section 'H,K-ATPase Activity Regulates Head Regeneration Through Membrane Voltage' (67.4% statement); protocol from Methods

injury: transverse amputation anterior and posterior to the pharynx (pharynx fragment)

intervention.timing: from amputation; 18 uM on day 1, refreshed on days 2 and 3
intervention.description: Pharynx fragments soaked in 18 uM SCH-28080 for the first 72 h after amputation

readout.method: external morphology of the regenerate scored under a stereomicroscope

notes: Only the headless percentage (67.4%) is given; n not stated, so percentages stored as counts summing to 100 and n_total null. 'other' (32.6%) = remainder not broken down by the paper; Results say the non-headless SCH pharynx regenerates included 'some' cyclopic (reduced anterior) animals, and any head-bearing animals are also in this remainder. Fig 1D bar chart holds the full distribution but no image is on disk.

adjudication.note: A gave headless only (sum 67.4); B added unclassified remainder to other so percentages sum to 100 per instructions; location taken from A
